title: 候機室
subtitle: Gate B28
core_positioning: 高成就都市女性，凌晨十二點半離開信義區辦公室，搭捷運回家時耳機裡放的歌。
core_meaning: 一個從小靠前進活著的人，突然開始懷疑自己是不是只會前進。

tempo.feel: walking pace, thinking while moving, not technical showoff flow

sound_palette.rhodes: old business hotel texture, slightly cold, lightly grainy
sound_palette.snare: organic woody snare, conversational, not digital trap
sound_palette.hihat: restrained 16th-note pattern with rare short rolls, no dense triplet rolls
sound_palette.sub_bass: subway passing underground, large but hidden, supports the headphone space without dominating
sound_palette.ambience: recreated airport-like ambience: suitcase wheels, elevator ding, air-conditioning tone, soft bilingual terminal feel
sound_palette.strings: very light, emotional saturation in final hook, not loudness explosion

vocal_production.main_delivery: Traditional Chinese Mandarin narrative rap, close-mic, almost speaking, no autotune
vocal_production.processing: light compression and warm tape saturation
vocal_production.hook: restrained half-rap half-melodic hook, first hook only slightly lifted
vocal_production.backing_vocals: light distant female harmony, especially final hook ooh layer

sections.name: Intro
sections.production: airport-like ambience, soft female announcement panned left/right, Rhodes enters

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.production: sparse office-at-midnight visual: Excel, glass, Taipei night reflection, success but empty

sections.name: Hook 1
sections.production: do not explode; slightly lift with pad and female harmony; leave large blank space

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.production: deeper self-analysis, tighter rap cadence against 88 BPM hesitation

sections.name: Bridge
sections.production: drop drums and bass completely; Rhodes plus plane-engine-like low ambience; four beats of silence after spoken line

sections.name: Verse 3
sections.production: rhythm returns smoothly, emotional setup for final hook

sections.name: Hook 2
sections.production: emotional saturation peak, not loudness peak; add light strings and layered distant female ooh

sections.name: Outro
sections.production: strip to engine ambience, low bass, Rhodes tail; final spoken line with sharp cut, no fade

instructions: do not rewrite the provided lyrics unless the model must shorten for timing
preserve section order and the hook wording

cover_art.composition: a woman in a tailored business suit sitting alone in an airport waiting area, all surrounding chairs empty, flight board refreshing behind her, destinations blurred, only B28 clear and sharp
